description: Recruited by Matt Graver, FBI agent Kate Macer joins a task force for the escalating war against drugs. Led by the intense Alejandro, the team travels back-and-forth across the U.S.-Mexican border, using one cartel boss to flush out a bigger one.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
description: A lavish trip through Europe quickly unfolds into a race against time to solve a murder aboard a train. Everyone's a suspect when Detective Hercule Poirot arrives to interrogate all passengers and search for clues before the killer can strike again.

title: Midsommar
description: A young American couple, their relationship foundering, travel to a Swedish midsummer festival where a seemingly pastoral paradise transforms into a sinister, dread-soaked nightmare as the locals reveal their terrifying agenda.

title: Flight Risk
description: A U.S. marshal boards a small plane to transfer a government witness to New York. As they cross the Alaskan wilderness, tensions start to rise as not everyone on the flight is who they appear to be.

title: The Bride!
description: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

title: Les Misérables
description: In 19th-century France, ex-prisoner Jean Valjean (Hugh Jackman), pursued for many years by ruthless policeman Javert (Russell Crowe), agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter.

title: Blockers
description: Lisa, Hunter and Mitchell learn that their teenage daughters plan to lose their virginity on prom night. The worried parents soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost.

title: Fuze
description: London undergoes a citywide evacuation when a World War II bomb is unearthed at a construction site. Amid the escalating chaos, a daring criminal operation is set in motion -- one that uses the evacuation as a cover for a meticulously planned heist.

title: The Long Walk
description: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

title: The Drama
description: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to "I do."
